note: Pisgah NF campground off Cold Springs Road near I-40 Exit 7 and Max Patch, also reached from Hot Springs by Meadowfork and Little Creek roads. The upper loop is a horse camp; the lower loop is for tents and small trailers. Gated: the lock combination comes with the reservation. In a bear sanctuary: food and waste in bear-proof containers. --Claude
summary: Forest Service-run (not concession), reservation-only on recreation.gov. Open in 2026: the calendar shows the 22 sites reserved/available through Oct 31, 2026, with no inventory Nov-Apr. Confirmed no hookups, 30-ft max, vault toilets, no drinking water, no walk-ups, $15. Added 9 back-in lower-loop sites, no dump, 24-hour cutoff, 14-night max, 2026 rate table. No Helene closure order names Harmon Den or Cold Springs Road on the NFsNC alerts page (Appalachian RD orders cover Shope Creek, Buzzard Roost, Ray Mine, Roan Mountain, Paint Rock). Not stated: a season (the May-Oct dates are a rate season), road surface or any clearance/4WD advice.
flags: Criteria note (weak): recreation.gov describes the lower loop as 'for tent campers and small trailers' / 'tent or dry trailer campers'; motorhomes are not named, and the catalog lists no permitted equipment for the 9 sites (each 'Max Vehicle Length: 30'). Nothing excludes a 23-ft motorhome, but nothing names one either.
